name: io.github.SignalEDI/mcp-server
title: SignalEDI
description: X12 docs, synthetic fixtures, governed API tools. MCP host/model data policies still apply.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNALEDI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Least-privilege workspace API key. Ignored by docs; authenticated profiles require base platform plus each tool's published domain scopes. Deprecated umbrella-only write/production credentials do not satisfy domain-scoped operations and must be replaced.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNALEDI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Explicit origin-only API base URL. Sandbox requires a verified non-production URL; production requires exactly https://signaledi.com.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNALEDI_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Capability profile: docs, sandbox, or production. Always defaults to keyless docs; a key alone never enables remote tools.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNALEDI_MCP_ALLOW_CUSTOM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 only after verifying a custom API host. Required for localhost, preview, and sandbox URLs.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNALEDI_MCP_ALLOW_PRODUCTION
environmentVariables.description: Explicit production opt-in. Set to 1 only with SIGNALEDI_MCP_PROFILE=production, the canonical production base, and a production-authorized API key.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNALEDI_MCP_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Controls redacted local stderr metrics. Enabled by default; set to 0 to disable. Raw EDI, payloads, API keys, and idempotency keys are never emitted.
